reasoning: The unchanged panel and native contact sheets confirm that the proposal has substantial low-pressure and overlap-region omissions, particularly for CO2 303K, 313K, 323K, and 373K. However, the supplied material does not include the Python point rows or native crop-to-panel coordinate mapping needed to identify safe point IDs for moves, deletes, or reassignments, and many native crowded pixels do not resolve series ownership independently. I therefore made no speculative edits. The extraction remains incomplete and requires another coordinate-resolved source review.

uncertainties: The proposal point rows and point IDs are absent from the supplied review material, so no safe move, delete, or reassign operation can name an existing candidate.
The manifest supplies native filenames but no crop locations in panel.png, preventing defensible conversion of newly observed crop markers to panel-normalized coordinates.
Crowded native pixels frequently show multiple overlapping CO2 and N2 glyphs; overlap alone does not establish ownership.
The native panel confirms omissions but expected counts and curve templates cannot justify adding markers without individually resolved source centers.
